native_query.sources: All six existing trained full-key Qwen branches, seeds 3/7/11, Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3.5-4B
native_query.requests: Distinct real official token prefixes and their original trained canonical row IDs; no random request or key replication
cache_regimes: warm OS with zero application cache
native_query.timing_rule: Same physical GPU and fixed cores within each paired lane; rotate method order. No cross-GPU speedup arithmetic. Contaminated cohorts are retained and excluded from primary exclusive-device claims.
native_query.io_rule: No machine-wide cache drop. New-handle or PTE-cold is not disk-cold. File-specific eviction may only affect new task-owned copies and must be verified.

independent_large_application.split: Seed-42 stratified 90/10 split of official training for training/calibration; full official test untouched
independent_large_application.representation: Word unigrams through order 4 over complete documents, Unicode word/punctuation tokenization, no document truncation; training-only exact canonical vocabulary
independent_large_application.model: 128-dimensional mean n-gram embedding bag plus linear classifier; zero-initialization primary and standard uniform(-1/dim,1/dim) sensitivity grid, independently seeded identical nonzero classifier for all table sizes
independent_large_application.domain_rule: Primary full/hash comparison shares zero embeddings for unseen canonical training keys. Native hash open-vocabulary behavior requires a separately labelled cohort.
independent_large_application.coverage: Every exact row except the reserved zero row must differ from its declared initialization and be finite. Publish actual observed size; never pad or replicate to reach a scale target. Both initialization conventions run the complete seed/rate/addressing grid (144 cells).
independent_large_application.selection: Lowest mean calibration cross-entropy selects learning rate within each addressing family, averaged across all three seeds. Test never changes selection. All losing training cells are retained.
compression_baselines: NGramStore composition over the same FAISS code bytes

host_backends: raw with the same staging/cache schedule
direct FAISS with the same staging/cache schedule
native with the same staging/cache schedule
inference.resident_control: Full resident table and matched hash controls; record genuine allocator OOMs and completed requests

independent_large_application.capacity_accounting: Include exact registry, word vocabulary, classifier, codebooks, forwarding metadata, cache metadata, staging and measured process/device memory. Branch-file savings and whole-process memory are separate.
independent_large_application.task_boundary: Standalone public n-gram classification is an independent task; it is not frozen-Qwen language-model performance or Engram pretraining.

calibration.separation: Construction/codec fit uses training rows. Calibration freezes all choices. Official test is confirmation only.
calibration.uncertainty: Paired document/case resampling, seed clusters, and simultaneous familywise confidence correction across all calibration choices; retain pointwise and simultaneous results distinctly.
calibration.fallback: If no candidate qualifies at a budget, retain the exact source. Calibration failure and held-out budget violation remain visible; neither is repaired by test reselection.

limits.ram_isolation: Container cgroups are read-only. RLIMIT_AS and software cache limits must not be presented as total-RAM caps. True total-RAM experiments require writable delegation; GPU allocator budgets have their own narrower declared scope.
limits.pressure: Task-owned bounded pressure workers only; no other user process termination, global limits or cache drops.
limits.publication: Raw corpora, keys, requests and trained weights remain untracked task artifacts. Numeric evidence capsules go to Release; checked-in content remains compact.
limits.claims: Full-key advantage, conditional containment similarity and codec efficiency are measured, never assumed universal. Negative cells remain in the full grid. Energy and monetary costs are unmeasured.
